title: Pixel art with AI.
author: hhkringel
selftext:
Hello Reddit.  
I aint a good artist at all, and i dont have the funds or anything to pay a person to help me out yet.  
I have some idea for a game I wanna vibecode a prototype for. But im having a hardtime getting the art style down and getting some solid outputs from Codex.

How are you guys doing it? Is there any special prompt?

Ive tried just asking it for pixelart and its just SUPER high res.  
But if I tell it to do a 64x64 px where each 64 pixels can only be ONE pixel, then it just creates really really badly looking blobs put together of odd shapes.

Could use some advice or help or tools.

comments.author: HugoDzz
comments.body: Claude is good for procedural, code-driven pixel art like FX, for sprites, style consistency, and animations, I use Sprite Fusion.
